purpose: Tap-to-load poster cards shown in place of the YouTube player for commentary videos on the Reading Room Ukraine desk (issue #71, sub-issue #84). The page loads the privacy-enhanced player only after a tap.
source: Drawn in code (gradient fields, grain, play mark and type) by an AI assistant for Infinity Enterprises. No photos, channel logos, profile pictures or faces.
fonts: Bodoni Moda and Inter, both SIL Open Font License 1.1
contrast_note: Measured against the 90th-percentile background luminance of the left 55% of each card, where all text sits. Worst case across the four files: name #f4efe6 12.8:1, labels #cfc8bd 8.8:1, kicker #d8c39a 8.5:1 (WCAG AA needs 4.5:1).
